DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: It's... noisy here. But there's a lot of stuff. I'll take a look while I wait.
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.ancient: Of course! In this dull wait, pick any forgotten gem you like!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.ancient: Still waiting, are you? No rush — take your time with that pile. You can afford to wait, and so can I!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.ancient: I have countless gems here, but I don't seem to see the one you're waiting for...
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char:
If you truly had the one I'm waiting for... it doesn't need to shine. It just needs to come when the time is right.
[i][font_size=22]Godot simply stood there, like a nail dulled by time.[/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancient: ......Forget it. Save your choice for next time. Seems you're accustomed to making "next time" wait a very long time.
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: You've pulled me from silence once again... This time, where shall I go to wait?
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char: If you grant me anything... grant me the strength to "wait just one more time." I need nothing else.
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancient:
[sine]...Go now... 
..I'll be... where you... look back... ..still here.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.cha: A splendid room. A dazzling you. Yet I... am just an old coat that hasn't been picked up yet.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.anc: Oh my, even an old coat can become radiant with my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.an: Are you waiting for a late victory? Come here, let me dress you up more like a winner.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.anc: Even if you must tether yourself to a moment that will never arrive, you shouldn't look so dusty and worn.
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.cha: ......I don't need to look good. I just need "it's not over yet."
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.anc: So unromantic. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting — wearing my light, and wearing your patience.
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: You're dancing. I'm waiting. Which one of us is crazier?
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.ancien: Neither!! Neither is crazy!! Try this to pass the time!!
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.ancie: Don't rush, don't rush! You must not rush! Waiting is... is... a very long lightning bolt!!
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.ancien: Giving you something!! What do you want? "A sound that still rings tomorrow"!?
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char: ......I've put silence in my pocket. Would you like to touch it?
OROBAS.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancien: Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep being noisy, you keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: Your snoring is like the tide... I wait within the tide — I won't drown, I'll only grow quieter.
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me, seek peace within the tide...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.ancient: [thinky_dots]Those awake always want to press forward, only those asleep know how to stay... why don't you rest a while too...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh... a bit of flesh that "won't hurry you"...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char: ......I'm not afraid of pain. I'm only afraid that pain will drag me away from waiting.
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take this... let you keep lying here... waiting for the road that hasn't come yet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.ancient: [b]NO!! Take this weapon! Go get stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.ancient: [b]Your blood went cold long ago! But battle can make even patience boil!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.ancient: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me — that is your destiny now!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char:
If we must fight... wait until the one I'm waiting for arrives. He'll return the blows for me.
[i][font_size=22]Godot stepped back half a step, as though yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancient: [b]Cowardice!! But you have boundless patience!! Take this weapon and go wait![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.cha: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth — it's "the right time."
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.anc: It's fine if the time hasn't come yet. Come inside, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up while we wait.
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.an: Is the only luggage you carry that little bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter]? Want me to burn it away for you?
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.anc: Dear, try these [jitter][b]treats[/b][/jitter] I've made for you. They're the kind that cool slowly, the kind you wait for.
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.cha: ......I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Empty looks a lot like hungry.
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.anc: Alright then, just a taste. Then we keep waiting — waiting for the bitterness to [jitter][b]fade[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0.char: Even demons make deals. So what do you want from me? My time? It was never worth anything.
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1.ancient: Worthless [sine]time[/sine], when accumulated, can be quite substantial...
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0r.ancien: I usually sell "right now" at a high price. But facing you, I want to mark up even [sine]"later"[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0.ancient: If I write a small line at the bottom of the contract: "Permitted to [sine]wait forever[/sine]" — would you sign?
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1.char: ......My name doesn't matter. What matters is I haven't been called yet.
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2.ancient: Take your price. I will never wake you — unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-0: You stand here, yet it's as though you're nowhere. What are you waiting for? The top of the tower? An ending? Or a word of permission?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-1: ......I'm waiting for a name to be spoken. Until it is, I'm going nowhere.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.0-2: Permission? You've never needed it. You're just afraid of "waiting for the wrong thing."
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-0: You've returned. Time is like a corridor to you — you can't finish walking it because you don't want to.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-1: A corridor is good. An end is not. An end means... no more need to wait.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.1-2: Foolish. If you don't walk toward the end, you'll forever remain just an echo.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-0: Then stand there. The tower will remember for you: you have come, many times, yet taken nothing away.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-1: Taking something... will it make me stop waiting?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2-MIYABI.2-2: Yes. So don't take anything. Keep waiting — that is the only weapon you ever mastered.
